description: Differences expected between ANY rebuild and the official Rocky RPM. Always loaded by rpm-parity (unless --no-default-allow). See docs/parity.md.

allow.reason: build time: ours is the changelog date (use_source_date_epoch_as_buildtime), Rocky's the wall clock
rpmbuild --rebuild carries the source package's cookie (Rocky's build host + time) into the binaries; Koji-built official binaries have none
installed size follows the (expected) ELF size differences; file sizes are compared per file
payload digest differs whenever any byte differs (ELF content, mtimes)
Rocky's build system sets %vendor; we do not claim Rocky's identity (buildSrpm vendor = null)
Rocky's build system sets %packager; we do not claim it (buildSrpm packager = null)
Rocky's build system sets %distribution 'Rocky Linux 10'; not set by our builds
Rocky's build system sets %bugurl https://bugs.rockylinux.org; not set by our builds
ELF objects are not bit-identical across builds (build-id, code layout); their properties are compared separately (elf.*)
static archives contain ELF objects (see content.elf); member lists are compared separately (ar.members)
debuginfo packages are not in the lock (Rocky ships them in separate debug repos)
debugsource packages are not in the lock (separate debug repos)
